notes.title: ⚡ PRIMAL PLANET UPDATE #4 – Optimisation
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Today I’m bringing you an update that’s been the most requested lately: ⚡ optimisation.[/p][p][/p][h3]🖥️ Tested on Lower-End Machines[/h3][p][/p][p]Thanks to this update, Primal Planet should now run better on lower-end machines — slightly older laptops and PCs should be able to handle the game much more smoothly.[/p][p]I tested the new build on an older laptop, and it ran surprisingly well:[/p][list][*][p][b]OS:[/b] Windows 10 64-bit[/p][/*][*][p][b]Processor:[/b] Intel Core i3-7100U @ 2.40GHz[/p][/*][*][p][b]Memory:[/b] 6 GB RAM[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphics:[/b] Intel HD Graphics 620 (Integrated)[/p][/*][*][p][b]DirectX:[/b] Version 11[/p][/*][/list][p]Note: The game was tested on integrated graphics. Performance may vary depending on your setup.[/p][p][/p][p]What’s more:[/p][p][/p][h3]💡 Visual Lighting[/h3][p][/p][p]Primal Planet features a Visual Lighting system that kicks in during sunrise, sunset, and nighttime — casting the world into darkness, while things like fire, glowing objects, and the player light up their surroundings.[/p][p]This adds a lot of atmosphere, but it can also impact performance.[/p][p]To help with that, there’s now an option to disable Visual Lighting in the PC version:
[b]Settings → Accessibility → Visual Lighting (OFF)[/b][/p][p]If you’re on a lower-end machine and still having performance issues, try turning Visual Lighting off to boost your framerate.[/p][p][/p][h3] Previous updates:[/h3][p][/p][p]Since the release of [b]Primal Planet[/b], I’ve published three major updates:  [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2350270/view/518594755730343201"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2350270/view/496078025817851671"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2350270/view/518597293118587345"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thanks for playing and supporting [b]Primal Planet[/b] 💚[/p][p]
– Albert van Zyl aka Seethingswarm[/p][p align="start"]Developer of Primal Planet[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2350270/Primal_Planet/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: 👽 PRIMAL PLANET UPDATE #3 – Alien Moon Base + Extended Ending!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone! [/p][p]It’s been a month since Primal Planet launched. Thanks so much to everyone who’s been playing, exploring, and sending in feedback. This third update adds a bit more to the late-game: a mysterious new area beyond the portal, new enemies to deal with, and an extension to the ending that gives a little more insight into the aliens. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871334/b0acbbd89572f0954f71aff055bf1820f7e1117d.png"][/img][/p][p]🚀 What’s New in This Update!

[/p][p]👽 ALIEN MOON BASE <:>:.:<.<[/p][p][/p][p]🌀 Step through the interstellar portal and discover a strange new world.[/p][p]🌌 Explore an otherworldly alien biome filled with new enemies, strange creatures, and atmospheric surprises.[/p][p]🧠 Face off against a new boss fight and experience an extended ending that reveals more about what the aliens are doing with the dinosaurs.[/p][p]👁️‍🗨️ This area adds new lore and late-game content for those who’ve journeyed deep into Primal Planet's secrets.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]🛠 OTHER FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/p][p][/p][p]🗺️ Corrected a portal location on the world map for better navigation.[/p][p]📈 Reduced the XP required to level up at higher levels. Progression should feel smoother for late-game explorers.[/p][p]🔋 Added a few more power cells across the world to help activate portals more reliably.[/p][p]🎨 Added credits for additional contributing artists and Godot, the game engine powering Primal Planet.[/p][p][/p][p]You can use your current save file, even if you've already finished the game - everyone should still be able to see the new ending no matter what.[/p][p][/p][p]That’s it for this patch! As always, thank you for playing, sharing feedback, and diving into the strange wilds of Primal Planet. If you’ve been enjoying your journey, consider leaving a review, it really helps others discover the game. 🦕💚


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871334/0840aa680c11105398a5881ea1aeb7da02b53517.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]– Albert van Zyl aka Seethingswarm[/p][p]Developer of Primal Planet[/p]

notes.title: 🦖 PRIMAL PLANET UPDATE #2 – Ride Dolphins + Map Upgrades!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871334/81acf03f3d49dfd81d041a9541bb940c6cbc579c.png"][/img]
Hey everyone!
[/p][p]Thank you all for the incredible support since launch. It’s been amazing to see your feedback, the secrets you’ve uncovered, and all the playthroughs popping up. This second update brings a splash of speed and clarity to your journey across Primal Planet, literally. 🐬🌊 Whether you’re still exploring or deep into the late game, this patch adds new ways to move, navigate, and uncover secrets.[/p][p]

🚀 What’s New in This Update![/p][p]

DOLPHIN RIDING! 🐬💨🌊
[/p][p]🐬 Swim up to a dolphin to auto-grab its fin and ride![/p][p]💨 Swim twice as fast[/p][p]｡˚○ No oxygen loss[/p][p]🎮 Full control over movement[/p][p]🌟 Bite with normal attack[/p][p]💦 Let go with roll/dash button[/p][p]🐬 Dolphins can also be found in rare deep locations[/p][p]

notes.title: 🛠 Post-Launch Patch #1 – Fixes & Improvements
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone,

It's been a week since Primal Planet launched, and I’ve been hard at work addressing as many bugs and issues as possible. I’ve been reading through all of your feedback and suggestions. Thank you so much for supporting the game and helping me make it better. I truly appreciate it.

I’m not done yet, but I wanted to push out a patch that tackles the most critical issues first. Here’s what’s been fixed and improved in this update:


FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS

🏆 ACHIEVEMENTS 
Steam achievements unlock instantly, instead of delayed.

🐈 METTE THE CAT
Fixed an issue where Mette doesn't follow the player and prevent an achievement from unlocking.

🕹 SAVING CUSTOM CONTROLS
Fixed control customization where buttons for "Use Item" and "Browse Items" didn't get saved.

🗺 MISSING MAP ICON
Added a missing portal icon on the map for Palmcrest Cove.

💥 GROUND SLAM
Fixed in issue where the groundslam effect still happens after the move has been interrupted.

🌊 SWIMMING
Fixed an issue where you daughter can appear on your back while underwater, even though she shouldn't be there.

💔 HURTING
Fixed in issue where the player can get hurt during certain cutscenes.

⛔ YOU SHALL NOT PASS
Fixed a part where the player could get through where they shouldn't.

💨 SWIM BOOSTERS
Swim Boosters restore your oxygen now.

⚔ MELEE ATTACKS
Fixed an issue where on some devices the player's melee attacks do no damage.


Thanks again for playing, reporting bugs, and sharing your thoughts. I’ve got more updates planned, so stay tuned, and keep sending that feedback!

If this patch improved your experience or fixed an issue you had, it would mean a lot if you’d consider updating your review, or leaving one if you haven’t yet. Every bit of support helps, especially as a solo dev!

—Seethingswarm
Developer of Primal Planet
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2350270/Primal_Planet/"][/dynamiclink]  [/p]

notes.title: Demo Update #2 - New Features, Bug Fixes, Remote Play, and More!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Dinovanians![/h2]

The second update for the Primal Planet demo is live, and it’s packed with improvements, new features, and some much-needed bug fixes. Thank you for all your feedback, it’s been a great help in making the game better! Let’s dive into what’s new:

[h3]🌟 Add-Ons[/h3]
🐠 A little [b]more variety of small fish[/b] to bring life to the waters
🌳 [b]Rare Spirit Trees[/b] that grant a Skill Point (there are 2 in the demo, can you find them both?)
🎵 [b]New music tracks[/b] for certain intense parts

[h3]🛠️ Improvements[/h3]
💾 [b]Permanent save function[/b] - finally, your progress is here to stay
🌪️ [b]Walljumping has been fine-tuned[/b] for a smoother experience
🏃 [b]Roll-jump momentum[/b] now carries through the entire jump 
📜 [b]Polish and Spanish translations[/b] have been added, and [b]Finnish translation[/b] has been improved (more languages on the way)

[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
🧱 No more roll-jumping into walls and getting stuck
❌ Fixed the exploit allowing walljumping straight up due to "coyote time"
🤝 Co-op backgrounds now display properly at the edges when the camera zooms out
⚡ Prevented barriers from going into a flashing loop after being hit. I couldn’t fully reproduce this bug, but I believe I’ve addressed the root cause. Let me know if it still happens!

[h3]🌐 Remote Play Together[/h3]
[b]I’ve enabled Remote Play Together for the demo![/b] Some of you asked about it, so I tested it with a friend, and it works great. You can even cast it to your phone and use Steam’s virtual controller! 😊

As always, thank you for playing and for all your feedback, it makes a huge difference! If you run into any issues or have suggestions, feel free to share them. I can’t wait to hear what you think of this update!

Seethingswarm
Primal Planet’s developer

[h2]Hello, Dinovanians![/h2]

A new version of the demo is live! I wanted to address a few issues that needed immediate attention. Hopefully, this update fixes them without causing a bunch of new ones 😜

[h3]🛠️ Patch Notes[/h3]
[b]Infinite death loop:[/b] Fixed a bug where getting hurt while activating a campfire could trap you in an endless loop of doom.
[b]Pause menu chaos:[/b] Resolved an issue where pressing "Escape" to exit campfire/hut menus triggered the pause menu instead.
[b]Invisible enemy bug:[/b] Attempted a fix for flying enemies getting stuck in a loop. I couldn’t reproduce the issue myself, so this one’s still under observation. If you encounter it, please share details!

[h3]🐞 Known Issues[/h3]
[b]The control setup can sometimes go haywire.[/b] Until I have a permanent fix, you can reset controls by going to Pause > Settings > Controls > Reset Controls.

Thanks again for playing and for all the feedback, it makes the game better every day. Let me know if you run into anything else!

Seethingswarm

notes.title: Life is finding a way on Primal Planet
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Dinovanians![/h2]

It's Albert van Zyl, the solo caveman behind this dinovania. I've been busy crafting Primal Planet into a living and mysterious world and writing a gripping prehistoric/sci-fi story with no dialogue and only action. It's been quite a journey so far and [b]I thought I'd share a bit about what's going on with the game's development and tell about some exciting stuff coming next.[/b]

[h3]The Foundation is Strong[/h3]
There are many features in Primal Planet! From battling enemies and upgrading skills to gathering resources, crafting, and building your village, there's a lot to dive into. You'll also encounter companions, experience rain and day-night cycles, explore with a map system, tackle boss fights, and, of course, face off against plenty of dinosaurs. Plus, you can enjoy all of this in local co-op! Each of these elements plays a key role in shaping the level design and overall gameplay. I made it a priority to solidify these mechanics before moving forward with the story and world-building. Now that the foundation is solid, the game is taking shape, and both the narrative and world are progressing well. There's still more to do, but it's exciting to see it all coming together 🙂

[h3]Primal Music[/h3]
I've been working with an incredible composer, [url=https://michaelkirbyward.bandcamp.com/]Michael Kirby Ward[/url], who’s crafting a fantastic soundtrack for Primal Planet. He’s already composed several amazing tracks, each packed with atmosphere and emotion, truly elevating the game to a new level. I can’t wait for you to experience the world of Primal Planet with his music!

[h3]Your Village[/h3]
One of the newest features in the game is your village. As part of a small tribe, you'll encounter lost cave dwellers throughout your journey who will rejoin your tribe. You can build huts for them in your village, which allows you to learn new skills from these characters and even hire them as companions. These huts also generate various resources for your tribe. You’ll also have the ability to move your village to different designated locations throughout the game world. I’m really excited about how this feature is shaping up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871334/8c69ea35e3558599c06b155e5ae3bab621d973ff.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871334/c02f53cbf9552c6f1464e53ae01d42686940f82b.png[/img]

[h3]A Demo in the Works[/h3]
I’ve been putting in a lot of effort to get a proper demo ready, and it looks like it won’t be too much longer now. I’ll have more details to share soon! 😉

[h3]Join the Dinovania[/h3]
Join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/caHrPTT6pJ][b]Discord community[/b][/url], follow on [url=https://x.com/ThePrimalPlanet][b]Twitter[/b][/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@primal_planet][b]TiktTok[/b][/url], [b]wishlist[/b] and [b]follow[/b] the game on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2350270/Primal_Planet/][b]Steam[/b][/url] to ensure you’re always kept in the loop.

Thank you all so much for your support so far — it truly means the world to me!

Seethingswarm
Primal Planet’s developer
